row.notes: float, default 1.25 (writable section); tyre_force_real torque multiplier on wet/inter tyres; set from plugin param forceWetMultiple (144701e82..f7f). Addon: < 1.0 = lighter wheel in the wet | findings from PR #472 by vogtmarcel07-cloud  | engine-re 2026-11-14: used at 0x144700c27 only when [[tyre+0xc0]]+0xf8 != 0 (wet / inter compound flag), i.e. it follows the fitted compound, not track wetness or rain; default otherwise 1.0 (xmm4).  raised by engine-re with --force 2026-11-14 at user request (lane owner review requested)

verify.notes: V9451 L2 check, blind re-derivation (own capstone disasm of work/exe/F1_25.exe, own rel32/riprel/abs64 scans). Initial value 1.25. Read at 0x144700c27 only when byte [[rdx+0xc0]+0xf8] != 0, else 1.0 (0x144700c0b-0x144700c25); written at 0x144701f7f from the parsed param (forceWetMultiple string in the param table). That the +0xf8 byte means wet/inter compound is inferred from the param name and from [wheel+0xc0] being the compound data (WetnessGrip spline at +0xec0), not proven here.
